description: Implement the `string` native module providing string constants: ascii_lowercase, ascii_uppercase, ascii_letters, digits, hexdigits, octdigits, punctuation, whitespace, and printable. These use the ConstantSymbol interface from FEAT-001 to expose string constants accessible as module attributes.
steps: Create directory stringmod/ (Go package name `stringmod` to avoid conflict with Go's `string` package) with stringmod.go containing const Name = "string" and func New() *module.NativeModule.

Implement each constant symbol (ascii_lowercase, ascii_uppercase, ascii_letters, digits, hexdigits, octdigits, punctuation, whitespace, printable) using module.NewConstant with types.Str. Each emit function allocates the constant string on the heap (using the Emitter to push a string constant).
Create stringmod/stringmod_test.go testing New() returns expected symbols and verifying they satisfy the ConstantSymbol interface.
Register the string module in compiler/module.go defaultRegistry() with import of the stringmod package.

Add compiler integration tests in compiler/string_module_test.go verifying `import string\nprint(string.digits)` outputs '0123456789' and `from string import ascii_lowercase\nprint(ascii_lowercase)` works.
Update docs/spec/06-builtins.md with a string module section.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./compiler passes including new integration tests for import string
